models.name: Bonsai 2 27B
models.params: 27.8B (ternary, ~1.72 bits per weight, based on Qwen3.8-27B)
models.why: A 27B compressed 9x to ~5.9GB of ternary weights that still keeps 98.2% of full-precision scores; the author's 4GB-VRAM/32GB-RAM box runs it in llama.cpp at 2.5 tok/s while a 12GB RTX 3060 holds a 220K context at ~35 tok/s with the PQ2_0 build.

engines.hardware: 4GB VRAM + 32GB system RAM (llama-server slot log: tg 2.50 t/s, ~12 tok/s prompt processing; the same machine runs Qwen 3.8 35B MoE faster)
engines.quant: quantized-down Bonsai 2 27B / Qwen3.8-27B build in llama-server
